# Python packages for build_images.py and the photo-metadata check in
# audit_blog.py (deploy.yml, blog-audit.yml), and — via requirements-og-cards.txt —
# build_og_cards.py (og-cards.yml). Exact pins with the sha256 of the CPython
# manylinux x86_64 wheels the runners install — cp312 for deploy/audit, cp313
# for og-cards — so pip runs in hash-checking mode and refuses anything else
# (`--only-binary :all:` keeps setup.py out entirely). Dependabot bumps pins
# and hashes together (see .github/dependabot.yml). Pillow >= 11.2 is the
# floor: AVIF.
Pillow==12.3.0 \
    --hash=sha256:78cb2c6865a35ab8ff8b75fd122f6033b92a62c82801110e48ddd6c936a45d91 \
    --hash=sha256:0847a763afefb695bc912d7c131e7e0632d4edc1d8698f58ddabec8e46b8b6d3
